snippet.title: Coal Duty | First Look Teaser | indie.io
snippet.description:
Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners have reportedly escaped. The state does not confirm this.

Wishlist the game now and get excited for the demo dropping on October 8th! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4272370/Coal_Duty/
